Not supported by the video card or the graphics API.
Needs depth of field set to High.
Shaders are rebuilt when the settings are applied: a short pause.
Applied by restarting the renderer when the settings are applied.
Applied at the next level load.

%c[255,150,150,150]Cost:%c[default] %c[255,110,200,90]none%c[default] \nNormal - two frames queued, steadier frame rate \nLow - one frame queued, faster response, may lower FPS

%c[255,150,150,150]Cost:%c[default] GPU (%c[255,110,200,90]reduces load%c[default]), VRAM (%c[255,110,200,90]low%c[default]) 
Linear - plain stretch to the screen size 
Nearest - pixelated stretch, developer builds only 
NVIDIA DLSS - rebuilds detail, NVIDIA cards, DirectX 12 
AMD FSR - rebuilds detail, DirectX 11 and 12 
Intel XeSS - rebuilds detail, DirectX 12 
%c[255,150,150,150]Only upscalers the video card supports are listed%c[default]

%c[255,150,150,150]Cost:%c[default] GPU (%c[255,235,80,60]high%c[default]), VRAM (%c[255,230,190,60]medium%c[default]) 
Native - full screen resolution 
Quality - 67% of the screen on each axis 
Balanced - 58% on each axis 
Performance - 50% on each axis 
Ultra performance - 33% on each axis

E (CNN) - older convolutional model 
K (Transformer) - transformer model, the default 
L (Transformer 2) - second-generation transformer 
M (Transformer 2, fast) - faster variant of L

%c[255,150,150,150]Cost:%c[default] GPU (%c[255,230,190,60]low to high%c[default]) 
Off - no edge smoothing 
FXAA - cheapest, slightly soft 
SMAA - sharper edges, a little more cost 
TAA - also calms shimmering in motion 
MSAA - extra samples on edges, costs the most

%c[255,150,150,150]Cost:%c[default] GPU (%c[255,235,80,60]high%c[default]), VRAM (%c[255,235,80,60]high%c[default]) 
2x - two samples per pixel 
4x - four samples, smoother edges 
8x - eight samples, smoothest and heaviest

%c[255,150,150,150]Cost:%c[default] GPU (%c[255,110,200,90]low%c[default]) 
Off - no motion blur 
Low - camera and object blur, fewer samples 
High - smoother blur, more samples

%c[255,150,150,150]Cost:%c[default] GPU (%c[255,110,200,90]low%c[default]) 
Off - no depth of field 
Low - classic blur of what is out of focus 
High - physically based camera
Physical depth of field while the inventory is open
Autofocus - focuses on what is in front of you \nManual - focuses at the distance its profile sets

%c[255,150,150,150]Cost:%c[default] GPU (%c[255,235,80,60]high%c[default]) 
Low - baked light only, no dynamic shadows or screen effects 
Medium - bump maps, highlights, simple IBL, sun shadows 
High - full shading, screen effects, detail bump, parallax 
Ultra - adds order-independent transparency, 8x anisotropy 
%c[255,150,150,150]Lower tiers limit several other settings%c[default]

%c[255,150,150,150]Cost:%c[default] GPU (%c[255,235,80,60]high%c[default]), CPU (%c[255,230,190,60]medium%c[default]) 
Off - lightmaps only, no dynamic shadows 
Low - one wide sun cascade over the lightmaps, 3x3 filter 
Medium - adds lamp shadows and HUD shadows, 5x5 filter 
High - three cascades, dynamic sun and lamps, detail shadows 
Ultra - not available yet
%c[255,150,150,150]Cost:%c[default] GPU (%c[255,230,190,60]medium%c[default]) \nShadows sharp near the caster and softer further away

%c[255,150,150,150]Cost:%c[default] GPU (%c[255,230,190,60]medium%c[default]) 
Off - no sun shafts, no volumetric lamps 
Low - coarse sun shafts, volumetric lamps 
Medium - smoother sun shafts 
High - sun shafts scattered in the fog 
Ultra - sun shafts in the fog, more samples

%c[255,150,150,150]Cost:%c[default] GPU (%c[255,230,190,60]medium%c[default]) 
Off - no ambient occlusion 
Low - darker corners, creases and contact spots, may shimmer 
Medium - adds surface detail and smooths the shimmer over frames 
High - not available yet
%c[255,150,150,150]Cost:%c[default] GPU (%c[255,235,80,60]high%c[default]) \nLow - occlusion and reflections at half size on each axis \nHigh - occlusion and reflections at full resolution

%c[255,150,150,150]Cost:%c[default] GPU (%c[255,230,190,60]medium%c[default]) 
Low - the sky and baked surroundings 
Medium - adds the reflection cube around the eye (offscreen reflections) 
High - adds screen-space reflections, the cube for what leaves the screen
Low - baked lighting only \nMedium - not available yet \nHigh - not available yet
Low - not available yet \nHigh - standard skipping of hidden objects
Low - not available yet \nHigh - standard geometry memory pool

%c[255,150,150,150]Cost:%c[default] VRAM (%c[255,235,80,60]high%c[default]), RAM (%c[255,230,190,60]medium%c[default]) 
Low - textures at quarter resolution, least video memory 
Medium - textures at half resolution 
High - full texture resolution 
Ultra - same as High for now
Low - not available yet \nMedium - standard texture loading \nHigh - not available yet

%c[255,150,150,150]Cost:%c[default] GPU (%c[255,110,200,90]low%c[default]) 
Off - no bloom 
Medium - bloom 
High - not available yet

%c[255,150,150,150]Cost:%c[default] GPU (%c[255,235,80,60]high%c[default]), CPU (%c[255,230,190,60]medium%c[default]) 
Low - sparse grass, full density up to 24 m 
Medium - denser grass, full density up to 40 m 
High - dense grass, full density up to 80 m 
Ultra - densest grass, full density up to 144 m 
Extreme - densest grass, full density and full detail to the end of the grass distance

Low - 100 m, coarsest distant models 
Medium - 300 m, coarse distant models 
High - 500 m, detailed distant models 
Ultra - 2000 m, most detailed distant models
